_readme: One object per case study. 'video' is a key from videos.json > library. Awards are linked from awards.json using 'slug'. To add a project, copy an object and give it a unique id + slug.

projects.title: AFTER DARK
projects.camera: ARRI ALEXA 35 / COOKE ANAMORPHIC /i FULL FRAME PLUS
projects.description: Exploring the boundary between light and shadow. An immersive nocturnal journey into the hidden rhythm of the metropolis after hours.

stills.caption: STILL 04: DAWN APPROACHES OVER THE SKYLINE

storyboards.note: Establishing wide tracking shot from high-altitude crane. Low key tungsten with amber sodium vapor lighting.
Close-up on protagonist eyes through wet windscreen. Rack focus to street reflections in 40mm Cooke Anamorphic.

projects.theIdea: We set out to capture the unseen pulse of a sleepless metropolis. Rather than treating darkness as an absence of light, we sculpted shadows as physical narrative characters.
projects.theFrame: Shot entirely on Arri Alexa 35 paired with custom de-tuned Cooke Anamorphic /i Special Flare lenses. The optical flare characteristics lent a melancholic, painterly amber quality to every streetlamp.
projects.theProcess: Over six consecutive night shoots across Tokyo's Shinjuku and Golden Gai back-alleys, our crew operated with ultra-compact gimbal rigs, practical haze generators, and specialized LED ribbon rigs hidden inside taxi cabs.
projects.theFinalCut: Finished in DaVinci Resolve Studio with a bespoke 35mm Eastman 5219 film emulation grain profile, retaining deep contrast while preserving rich skin tonalities.

projects.title: AETHERIA
projects.camera: RED V-RAPTOR XL 8K VV / LEITZ PRIMES
projects.description: A sci-fi high-concept fashion film exploring speculative human evolution in zero-gravity synthetic atmospheres.
projects.theIdea: Bridging avant-garde haute couture with photorealistic cosmic simulations, examining how clothing and human form adapt to interstellar environments.
projects.theFrame: Hyper-detailed 8K capture combined with physically-based Houdini fluid simulations rendered in Unreal Engine 5.4.
projects.theProcess: Volumetric motion capture performances staged against massive 360-degree LED volume stages, allowing practical interactive amber light to bathe the talent.
projects.theFinalCut: Paced to an ethereal ambient score produced in-house, blending acoustic cello with sub-bass frequency swells.

projects.title: VELOCITY
projects.description: An adrenaline-fueled visual poem capturing aerodynamic perfection at 1,000 frames per second on the salt flats of Utah.

stills.caption: STILL 01: CARBON FIBER AT SPEED OF SOUND
STILL 02: DUST PLUME VORTEX AT SUNSET

projects.theIdea: Translating raw kinetic horsepower into sensual, liquid movement. We avoided traditional car-commercial clichés in favor of high-speed macro cinematography.
projects.theFrame: Shot at 1,000 FPS on the Phantom Flex 4K paired with high-speed tracking Russian Arm camera cranes.
projects.theProcess: Four days in extreme heat conditions on the Bonneville Salt Flats with custom aerodynamic camera mounts.
projects.theFinalCut: Dynamic speed ramping synchronized to raw analog engine telemetry recordings.

projects.title: ECHOES OF SILENCE
projects.description: An intimate portrait of solitary high-altitude monks surviving the brutal winters of the Zanskar Himalayan range.
projects.theIdea: Documenting the spiritual stillness of one of the most remote inhabited places on Earth before climate shifts permanently alter their ancient way of life.
projects.theFrame: Natural light only. Utilizing the Dual Base ISO 3200 of the Sony Venice 2 to capture candlelit prayers and moonlit snowy summits.
projects.theProcess: A 4-person expedition crew living self-sustained for 28 days at sub-zero temperatures with solar-recharged batteries.
projects.theFinalCut: Spiritual, meditative pacing with real field recordings mixed in Dolby Atmos 7.1.4.

projects.title: CHRONO OBSCURA
projects.description: An avant-garde visual opus blending physical 35mm film manipulation, bleach bypass processing, and reactive laser projections.
projects.theIdea: Physical destruction and rebirth of analog celluloid. We hand-bleached individual 35mm film strips to manifest visceral psychological unraveling.
projects.theFrame: Shot on legendary Kodak Vision3 500T with custom optical prism filters attached directly to the camera matte box.
projects.theProcess: Analog photochemical lab processing merged with high-end digital compositing in Flame and Nuke.
projects.theFinalCut: Kinetic, rhythmic edit that locks frame transitions to 140 BPM electronic polyrhythms.

projects.title: MONOLITH
projects.description: A brutalist architectural study exploring monumentality, shadow geometries, and human solitude across modernist concrete structures.
projects.theIdea: Treating monumental concrete architecture as living sculpture. The dialogue between the ephemeral human presence and eternal monolithic stone.
projects.theFrame: Large Format 65mm sensor for extraordinary geometric fidelity, vanishing perspective lines, and clean edge-to-edge optical resolution.
projects.theProcess: Filmed across iconic brutalist landmarks in London, Berlin, and Brasilia during optimal astronomical shadow alignment windows.
projects.theFinalCut: Stately, measured camera tracking moves with pure spatial silence and binaural architectural reverberations.
